submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 offers the highest signal efficiency (92.6%) at the allocated 8 kHz Level-1 trigger rate with a 35 GeV threshold, as demonstrated by both the simulation and the summary document. It meets FPGA resource and optical link constraints, with no indication of exceeding the 4.0 μs Level-1 latency constraint. This configuration maximizes physics reach within given requirements.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 is explicitly included among the three candidates in candidate_specs.md.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm's latency on the Level-1 FPGA hardware must not exceed 4.0 us.
requirements.evidence: All candidate algorithms are stated to fit within FPGA resource and bandwidth; no evidence of a latency violation in available documentation.
Threshold of 35 GeV is within the 20 to 60 GeV window.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.
requirements.evidence: One candidate (Algorithm-L3) with threshold (35 GeV) is recommended.
